entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hello Isaac. I'm having an issue with my new VeloBand GPS Tracker.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference matter?
It's a technical fault. The main reason I bought it, the pulse tracker, is just not working. It either shows nothing or a completely random number.
I see. I'm sorry to hear you're experiencing that. So the pulse data won't sync correctly to your app either?
Exactly. It won't sync at all. The step counting works, but the heart rate monitor seems completely broken. I think the unit is defective.
Okay, that definitely sounds like something we need to resolve. Do you have your order number handy so I can pull up your account?
Thank you. Let me just pull that up... Okay, I see the order. It looks like it was delivered to you 39 days ago, on December 15th.

Right, that sounds correct. Look, I know it's been over a month, but since it's defective, I was hoping we could work something out. I don't need a full refund, necessarily. Maybe a discount code for a replacement?
Actually, there's no need to worry about that. I'm checking our policy, and you are well within the return window.
Oh, really? I thought I had missed the deadline.

Not at all. Our policy allows for returns on any item within 90 days of delivery. Since the band is broken, I can go ahead and process a full return for you right now. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email on file as we speak.
Wow, that's fantastic. Thank you, Isaac. That's much easier than I expected.
You're very welcome. Once our warehouse receives the defective unit, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
